thread:
Priya Shah: Quick sync — engineering says we need a firm cutline for the Q3 milestone by EOD Fri. Can't land all v1 features. Thoughts?
Miguel Ramos: Agree. perf work + infra still shaky. We should freeze MVP scope and move some items to v1.
Ben Carter: Which items are high-risk? list?
Priya Shah: Short list below. I think we keep auth, basic routing, usage telemetry in MVP. Everything else optional.
Leah Wong: +1. Customers need a stable API first. Can we tolerate a 2-week rollforward for multitenancy?
Jonathan Li: If we roll to Q4 we avoid rushed infra changes. But sales promised pilot in Sep.
Miguel Ramos: Proposal: freeze MVP featureset by Fri; allow non-blocking soft-features to be delayed. Define gating criteria: perf SLOs met, e2e test pass, infra autoscale verified.
Priya Shah: Gating criteria sounds good. Can we define numbers? e.g., p95 < 250ms for 95% of baseline traffic, error rate < 0.5%.
Ben Carter: Those SLOs are reasonable. Add cost-per-token cap for hosted tier? Sales will ask.
Priya Shah: Good point. Add max infra spend delta < 20% vs forecast for MVP.
release-bot: Deploy check triggered: canary tests failing on 2/5 endpoints — ops investigating :eyes:
Miguel Ramos: That canary failure is why we shouldn't promise Sep pilot. Recommend communicating a soft target and offering early access to select customers.
Leah Wong: Draft message for sales/customer success: "We are locking MVP feature set to ensure stability; key advanced features will ship in v1. We can provide early-access program for pilot customers." Thoughts?
Ben Carter: LGTM. Add guidance: any feature wanting to be in MVP must have an owner, test plan, and rollback plan by Thu.
Priya Shah: Action items:
- Priya: finalize cutlist + publish to roadmap doc (by Thu noon)
- Miguel: triage canary failure + ETA (today)
- Ben: write MVP acceptance checklist + SLOs (Thu EOD)
- Leah: coordinate customer comms and pilot offers (Fri)
Jonathan Li: I'll notify the sales leads and ask them to nominate pilot customers.
Priya Shah: If no objections, we'll freeze by EOD Fri and do a public note to stakeholders. :thumbsup:
Leah Wong: No objections from Eng/Product here. :white_check_mark:
Miguel Ramos: Agree. Thanks all.
Ben Carter: Thanks — will update the doc with the checklist link once ready.
Priya Shah: Ok closing thread, we'll follow up in the Asana card and roadmap doc.
